title: Launch and diagnostic: transition stress and why capable people struggle during it
focus: transition stress and why capable people struggle during it
essentialQuestion: How do I keep myself steady through a transition that removes most of my structure?
keyPoints: Transitions increase uncertainty, role change, workload, and loss of familiar support; struggling during change can reflect load and access rather than lack of ability.
Match the response to the level of need: use a practical coping step for ordinary strain, add trusted support when functioning is disrupted, and use urgent help for immediate danger.
